foraged.title: Panama by Air (Reel 4) (1914)
foraged.author: via movingimagearchive.com
foraged.what_it_shows: the noise floor of a 1914 silent film print's sound transfer: steady hiss with faint crackle, no voice or music (spectrum and level checked: -48 dBFS median, no onsets)
foraged.used_as: room tone bed under the whole film (S0-S12); 11 s seamless loop (1 s crossfade), band 60-7000 Hz, RMS -42 dBFS
foraged.verified_date_or_place: title/year on movingimagearchive.com page; pre-1929 US film

foraged.title: File:Clock ticking.ogg
foraged.author: natalie
foraged.what_it_shows: a mechanical clock ticking once a second, close-miked, quiet room
foraged.used_as: clock_tick (tick at 3.07 s), clock_tick_close (tock at 4.08 s, louder, S5), pencil_tap (the same tick band-passed 1.5-9 kHz, quiet: the pencil tapped on the temple, S1)

foraged.title: File:Squeaky door.ogg
foraged.author: leonmire
foraged.what_it_shows: a squeaking hinge as a door is swung, then shut (the shut at 7.0 s is not used)
foraged.used_as: door_creak (4.55-5.75 s): the cupboard door's swing on its jamb, S7 f42-f54

foraged.title: File:Door handle creaking.ogg
foraged.author: stephan
foraged.what_it_shows: a door handle turned, its latch clicking and creaking
foraged.used_as: door_latch (0.30-0.62 s): the cupboard latch gives, S7 f40

foraged.title: File:Creaky wooden swivel chair.ogg
foraged.author: chocoholic
foraged.what_it_shows: a wooden swivel chair creaking and shifting as someone moves in it
foraged.used_as: chair_scrape (3.66-4.25 + 4.40-4.75 s): the clerk rises from his chair, S2 f22

foraged.title: File:Church people walking steps with reverb.ogg
foraged.author: stephan
foraged.what_it_shows: people walking on a hard floor in a reverberant church; individual heel strikes are audible over the hall
foraged.used_as: footstep_1..6 (single strikes gated to 0.12 s + 30 ms decay, band 90-6000 Hz: the clerk's steps on the office boards, S2/S3/S4/S7) and steps_receding (6 strikes fading and darkening: the visitor leaving, S6)

foraged.title: File:Dull thud.ogg
foraged.author: gregoryweir
foraged.what_it_shows: a short dull thud of something soft landing
foraged.used_as: paper_tap: band-passed 0.7-9 kHz and shortened so it reads as a card landing; every balloon land frame (S4 f40, S5 f56, S6 f16, S8 f84)

foraged.title: File:Train sounds from Iowa - Glaneur de sons.ogg
foraged.author: Glaneur de sons
foraged.what_it_shows: an old tourist train in Iowa: engine and wheels at a distance, outdoor air
foraged.used_as: platform_distant (40-50 s, low-passed 1.4 kHz, RMS -34 dBFS): the platform beyond the ticket window, S6 and S11
foraged.attribution: Glaneur de sons, CC BY 3.0 (credit required)

synthesized_declared.made_with: kit.Mix.bell (inharmonic struck-bell partials) at 2350 Hz + kit.Mix.click strike, 2.4 s decay

synthesized_declared.used_as: the counter bell rung once by the visitor, S4 f14 (and S10/S11)

synthesized_declared.made_with: kit.Mix pink noise band-passed 0.9-7.5 kHz, three enveloped bursts
synthesized_declared.why: no openly licensed paper-handling recording found in time (Commons 'sound effect paper' returned none; 'Gravity Sound paper' returned only PDFs)
synthesized_declared.used_as: S0: the sheet laid down as the borders rule in (quiet)

absences.wanted: Moving Image Archive clip foley (footsteps, door, bell, clock)
absences.searched: index.json: all 188 clips with audio; regex station|office|clock|door|train|railroad|footstep|walk|room|desk|bell|ticket|platform; auditioned by spectrum: Wreckless 1935, This Is My Railroad 1940, Dating: Do's and Don'ts 1949, Going Steady? 1951, Valley Town 1940 (2 clips), Space Ship Takeoff 1937, Panama by Air 1914
absences.result: all but Panama by Air carry narration, dialogue or score over the sound; only Panama by Air (silent film, transfer noise) is usable, as room tone
